C1456.title: Side-Channel Attack on Tesla Model S Key Fob
C1456.summary: In 2018, researchers at KU Leuven performed a cryptographic attack against the Tesla Model S keyless entry system, also describable as a key fob cloning attack. Attackers combined radio-frequency capture and computation to exploit weaknesses in the key fob authentication mechanism, clone the vehicle key, and enter the car. If this is called a side-channel attack, a paper or technical report explicitly classifying the Tesla case as such should be added.
